'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Matt Scott LS Endor''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Scott]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor (location)|Endor-L-endor.gif|label=Endor}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
